job_title: Arquiteto de Software Sênior - Remoto com Remuneração PJ de até 24k
summary: Design and evolve mission-critical distributed software, APIs and integrations. Guide developers, review code, translate business requirements into architecture, define security/performance/observability standards, support cloud decisions and troubleshoot systems.
requirements: Solid software architect, technical lead or senior development experience with architecture; object-oriented development; distributed systems; functional/non-functional requirements; APIs, microservices, integrations, cloud and security/performance/scalability. AWS is preferred. Desired experience across a significant subset of Java, JavaScript, Angular, Stencil.js, Elasticsearch, MongoDB, AWS, REST, events, Git, CI/CD, Docker and Kubernetes. Plus: low-code/BPM, corporate transformation, critical integrations and architecture/cloud certifications. No minimum year count or degree requirement is disclosed.
compensation: BRL 18,000–24,000 per month, PJ; final amount depends on experience and fit.
conditions: 100% remote PJ contract. The description uses "hybrid" to describe the combination of architecture and hands-on development duties, not office attendance.
